section2.title: The Foundation of Intelligent Business Decisions

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.text: Enterprise decision-makers depend on manual reports and delayed analytics. Critical data arrives days after the decision window closes — costing revenue, efficiency, and competitive advantage. Data on Demand eliminates this delay with specialized AI agents that understand your unique business context in real time.

solution.text: Domain-trained AI intelligence systems built on patterns unique to each industry vertical. Data on Demand replicates elite consulting teams — identifying root causes, modeling business scenarios, and surfacing strategic decisions at the moment they matter most.

cards.description: Pre-trained across manufacturing, logistics, retail, energy, BFSI, and government sectors — delivering day-one intelligence without lengthy setup.

cards.title: Connected Decision Intelligence
cards.description: Links cross-functional interdependencies automatically — procurement impacts on cash flow, fleet downtime on delivery SLAs, pricing changes on margin.

cards.title: Ask. Understand. Act.

steps.title: Integrate
steps.text: Connect every enterprise data source — ERP, CRM, IoT, spreadsheets, and APIs — in minutes. One unified, clean, query-ready data layer across your entire organization.
